title: seed: the duplicate-fallback refusal still names "an upgrade within this process" as a cause, which the install door no longer produces after #35109
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaysxGzF62ACvZ1x9x

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding (class b, named producer): the os-dev round of #35109 (PR #35374, report 7002155117), read from code; outside that card's file surface. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`). Suggested-grade: p3 · wording only. Rides the same-file p2 PR of #34857 + #35336 (area pkg-1).
Dedupe: `duplicate fallback refusal upgrade within this process` in open issues: none.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：示例数据里「同一对象有两个兜底语种集」的报错，现在不会再说「可能是本进程里升级了包」这个已经不存在的原因。
- 为什么做：升级后旧版本数据不再留在重放清单上，这句原因已经不成立，会误导排查。
- 出错会怎样：只是报错文字；改错了最多文字不准，行为不变。
- 要你做什么：无（分诊定级）。

## What happens

`seed-loader.ts` `findDuplicateFallbackSets`' refusal text (~:5536-5537) and docblock (~:5508) name a second cause: "an upgrade within this process changed a package's marked set (the earlier version's datasets stay on the replay list until the process restarts)". After PR #35374 (#35109) the install door replaces a package's entries on upgrade, so that cause no longer arises. The remaining cause is two different packages marking one object. Pinned by `seed-loader-locale-scope.test.ts:~486`.

## Expected

The refusal and docblock name only the cause that still arises; the pin follows. Land after PR #35374.
